purpose: Audit training-budget and input/output-scale sensitivity of direct versus persistence-anchored Hofen sequence models.
paired_controls: Same 21-channel information, 48-h sequence windows, architecture, initial weights, batch permutation seed, optimizer, learning rate and training/validation split within each architecture/variant/seed pair.

variants.legacy: Original log-current-emission input and uncentred target/residual divided by its respective training SD.
variants.centered: Original log-current-emission input with training-only centring/scaling of the direct target or anchored residual.
variants.raw_anchor: Replace the log-current-emission channel by raw current emission, with training-only centring/scaling of outputs; no extra input channel.

full_training_refit.test_access: Only after fitting completes; no test-based checkpoint or budget selection.

scale_estimator_clarification: The coded legacy direct recipe retains whole-fit pandas SD ddof=1. Legacy anchored scaling and all centred target/residual scales use eligible-sequence NumPy SD ddof=0. Centred variants also estimate the eligible-sequence target/residual mean. The centred direct comparison therefore includes this small harmonization of the SD estimation pool/convention, not only subtracting the mean.
learning_curves: Training RMSE uses one fixed random subset of up to 4096 eligible fit sequences. Inner validation RMSE uses all eligible validation origins. Full-refit validation RMSE is undefined because these validation observations enter the refit.
runtime: RTX4060 Laptop GPU; isolated PyTorch 2.13.0+cu126; deterministic algorithms and float32 with TF32 disabled. The installed cuDNN recurrent kernel caused native Windows interpreter-shutdown failures even in a minimal GRU probe. Normal calculations, saved outputs and repeated training are independently verified. Only after successful completion, CUDA synchronization and file/stdout flush, this Python worker is explicitly terminated by Windows TerminateProcess to bypass the faulty DLL teardown. Exceptions never enter that completion path.
historical_comparison_boundary: These are matched new refits, not bitwise reproductions of historical CPU predictions. Batch permutations are generated by a separate paired generator, independently of dropout RNG.
limitations: The July-December validation period does not contain a January peak.
All four architectures are compared at seed 42; the additional initialization audit is limited to GRU, using seeds 42, 43 and 44.
The fixed-epoch comparisons share budgets; validation-selected comparisons may use different epoch counts for the two formulations.
